context.purpose: Threshold one calibrated 8/16-bit grayscale image with headless ImageJ 1.54 and publish verified per-particle measurements (pixel count, area, centroid, bounding box and raw intensity mean/min/max) in declared physical units, ready for Calc or a later R analysis. A second operation, measureRegions, applies one named rectangle list to 2-8 captured planes with declared frame IDs and times and publishes a labelled per-frame, per-region table.
context.assumptions: ImageJ 1.54 ij.jar (latest release 1.54t qualified) run by a Java 11+ runtime with the jdk.compiler module; a fixed Java source program uses public ImageJ classes headlessly with isolated preferences. Declared pixel width/height and unit replace any calibration stored in the file. Thresholds are inclusive raw stored intensities.
context.constraints: One .pgm (P5, maxval 255 or 65535) or uncompressed single-IFD BlackIsZero 8/16-bit unsigned .tif/.tiff, at most 2048 px per side, 1048576 px and 16 MiB; no colour, stacks, ROI, density calibration or inverted LUT. Manual inclusive threshold only; full-range thresholds are rejected. Eight or four connectivity; four requires includeHoles. Size filter is converted to inclusive whole-pixel counts. At least one and at most 4096 particles. Units nm, um, mm, cm or m; pixel size 1e-6..1e6 per side. No arbitrary macros, scripts, plugins or Fiji launcher. measureRegions: 2-8 same-size, same-depth planes (4194304 px and 32 MiB total), 1-16 zero-based top-left integer rectangles (right/bottom exclusive, fully inside every frame, overlap allowed), safe unique frame/region IDs, strictly increasing finite seconds; no thresholds, motion, registration or overlay.
context.inspection: particles.csv has one row per particle in ImageJ raster order with unit-bearing column names. particle-summary.json retains image digest/format/bit depth, calibration and coordinate convention, threshold, connectivity, filters, rejected counts, totals and area fraction. count-mask.pgm, native tables and readbacks remain as evidence.
context.recovery: INVALID_THRESHOLD: order the bounds and stay within the image bit depth; do not select every pixel. UNSUPPORTED_OPTION: four connectivity needs includeHoles true. INVALID_SIZE_FILTER: widen the area window to contain a whole pixel count. NO_PARTICLES: inspect thresholdPixels and rejected counts, then adjust threshold or filters. INVALID_IMAGE/UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE: convert to a supported plain grayscale PGM/TIFF. INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND: configure Java (imagej) and ij.jar (imagejJar). UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME: use ImageJ 1.54 and Java 11+. VERIFICATION_FAILED: keep the run directory and start a fresh attempt. DUPLICATE_FRAME_ID/DUPLICATE_REGION_ID/INVALID_IDENTIFIER: use unique safe IDs. NON_INCREASING_TIME: list frames in strictly increasing seconds. REGION_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: keep each rectangle inside every frame. SERIES_MISMATCH: supply equal width, height and bit depth. RESOURCE_LIMIT: reduce the series or rectangles.

lifecycle.logs: Retain authored/effective plans, the copied input image, fixed Java program, runtime record, java -version output, both stage submissions/stdout/stderr, native readbacks, native and reopened tables, count mask, publications and failure results.
lifecycle.verification: An independent dependency-free PGM/TIFF decoder and connected-component model (raster order, inclusive threshold, 8/4 connectivity, enclosed-hole fill, bounding-box edge exclusion, whole-pixel size window) predicts every particle. Native ParticleAnalyzer rows, every count-mask label and a fresh-process ImageStatistics re-measurement of each label must match within 1e-12 relative. Native readback confirms ImageJ version, decoded dimensions/depth/plane count, consumed input digest, declared calibration and unit, threshold and analyser options. Publications and evidence are digest-bound and the summary is recomputed. measureRegions: an independent exact enumeration of every pixel of every rectangle in every captured frame (integer count, minimum, maximum, Fraction mean; area and geometry within 1e-12 relative) checks ImageStatistics rows and a fresh-process ImagePlus/Roi readback, which also reads back frame labels and rectangle names, calibration and source digests.

cases.scope: Synthetic 64x48 8-bit target, threshold [100,255], 8-connected, 0.5 um square pixels. Eight particles of 20, 60, 64, 1, 72, 108, 4 and 18 pixels (347 px = 86.75 um^2). The ring excludes its 6x6 hole and the 2x2 island inside it is a separate particle; corner-touching 3x3 squares form one 18-pixel particle. Centroids are pixel-centre means; the L shape is ((588/72)+0.5, (1956/72)+0.5)*0.5 um.

includeHoles fills the ring (144 px) and absorbs the island: mean (108*160+32*20+4*230)/144 = 130.8333 with min 20 and max 230. excludeEdges drops the border block and minimumArea 0.5 um^2 (2 px) drops the single-pixel speck: five particles, 358 px = 89.5 um^2.
4-connectivity separates the corner-touching squares into two 9-pixel particles and fills the ring (ImageJ requires holes for 4-connected tracing): 20+60+64+1+72+144+9+9 = 379 px = 94.75 um^2.
Lower bound 180 is inclusive, so the square of intensity exactly 180 stays. The ring (160) and speck (150) drop out and the 230 island becomes its own particle: 20+60+64+72+4+18 = 238 px = 59.5 um^2.
Rectangular 0.25 x 0.5 mm pixels: area = pixels*0.125 mm^2 (347 px = 43.375 mm^2); x quantities scale by 0.25 and y by 0.5. Column names carry the mm unit.
Big-endian two-strip 16-bit TIFF with intensities 100x the 8-bit target. Lower 18000 is inclusive and above the 8-bit range: six particles, 59.5 um^2, square mean 18000.

Analytic 12x8 8-bit ramps v=10+8x+12y+20f, four frames at 0, 30, 60 and 90 s, 0.5 x 2 um rectangular pixels. Rectangles core(2,1,4x3), edge(8,5,4x3; right and bottom flush with the frame) and nested(3,2,2x1; inside core, so the measurements overlap). Closed form per rectangle: mean = ramp at the rectangle centre, minimum and maximum at its corners: core 62/38/86, edge 158/134/182, nested 62/58/66, each plus 20 per frame; counts 12, 12, 2; areas 12, 12, 2 um^2 (count x 0.5 x 2).

Analytic 12x8 16-bit little-endian TIFF ramps v=1000+900x+1700y+3000f, three frames at 0, 12.5 and 100 s, 0.25 x 0.5 mm pixels (0.125 mm^2). whole(0,0,12x8: 96 px = 12 mm^2) contains centre(4,2,4x4: 16 px = 2 mm^2); whole mean 11900, min 1000, max 22800; centre mean 11900, min 8000, max 15800, each plus 3000 per frame.

Fractional-mean 9x6 8-bit planes v=(29x+53y+17f+11xy) mod 256, three frames at 0, 12.5 and 40 s, 0.5 x 1.5 um pixels (0.75 um^2, so area is 0.75 x count, not the count). Rectangles third(1,2,3x1: sums 368, 419, 470, means 368/3, 419/3, 470/3), sevenths(0,2,7x1), corner(6,3,3x3), pixel(8,5,1x1) and whole(0,0,9x6; contains the others, so rectangles overlap). 12 of the 15 means are non-integral (non-terminating decimals such as 122.666...); expectations are independent Fractions from the closed formula, never from Schemaxis or ImageJ output.

Fractional-mean 9x6 16-bit little-endian TIFF planes v=(4099x+7919y+1013f+977xy) mod 65536, three frames at 0, 7.25 and 20 s, 0.25 x 0.4 mm pixels (0.1 mm^2 each). Rectangles third(4,3,3x1: sums 111185, 114224, 117263; means 111185/3 etc.), block(2,2,3x3) and whole(0,0,9x6). 7 of the 9 means are non-integral; expectations are independent Fractions from the closed formula.
